name: ai-coding-project-boilerplate
tagline_zh: 厌倦了AI写代码跑偏？这套TypeScript样板内置子代理质检，让Claude Code每次提交前自动查错。
tagline_en: Tired of AI coding off-track? This TS boilerplate embeds sub-agent QA, so Claude Code self-checks before every.
desc_en: Agentic coding TypeScript boilerplate for Claude Code: sub-agent workflows with built-in quality checks and context engineering.
why_zh: 同类样板只管生成，它管验收：子代理分工+内置检查，让AI输出质量可预期，省去你反复review的力气。
why_en: Unlike scaffolds that just generate, this one verifies: sub-agent workflows with built-in checks make AI output predictable.
